contexts.text: The Lord is called Shiloh from the fact that He has pacified and made all things calm; for, in the Original, Shiloh is derived from a word which means what is calm.
Men from Shiloh, etc. () = those who profane; and profanations.
Until Shiloh come () = the Lord's advent and the tranquillity of peace then.
The habitation of Shiloh () = the Church which is in the good of love.
(Shiloh as one of the Lord's names.)
